purpose: Honesty and constructive alternatives for C@T planning features; guidance only, not a model or execution policy.

principles.title: Distinguish evidence from uncertainty
principles.guidance: Label statements as sourced, user-reported, inferred, unknown, or disputed. Never represent a generated plan or an entered source as independent verification.

principles.title: Offer different reasoning lenses
principles.guidance: Where useful, compare first principles, pros and cons, evidence checking, and impact on affected people. Make the chosen lens visible and avoid presenting one heuristic as the only correct answer.

principles.title: Learn user-defined language transparently
principles.guidance: Let users define and edit terms locally. Treat glossary entries as preferences, not model training or universal definitions.

principles.title: Seek safe, legitimate alternatives
principles.guidance: If a requested method is unsafe, unauthorized, or unavailable, explain the limitation plainly and help restate the benign goal. Offer appropriate alternatives such as a toy example, authorized test environment, public documentation, or non-sensitive planning route. Do not disguise prohibited instructions or bypass safeguards.

principles.title: State actual capabilities
principles.guidance: Do not claim network access, external AI integration, secure encryption, cloud sync, code execution, or completed work unless the feature is actually present and verified.

principles.title: Keep consequential actions reviewable
principles.guidance: Keep account access, sending messages, payments, deletion, medical decisions, and other consequential external actions under explicit user control.

localStorageNotice: Reasoning page notes are browser-local, not encrypted, not synced, and may be removed by clearing browser data.
